messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — prepping hotfix PR #7824 for the kv-cache regressions. CI is green but we need 2x LGTM before the 22:00 UTC cutover. Can folks spare quick eyes? :hourglass: 

maria: on it, will skim now. any schema changes I should watch for?

sanjay: no schema changes. main tweak is batching backpressure threshold and a tiny guard on cache evictions.

jamie: pinging @maria and @lina for second eyes, I can do a full pass in ~30m.

lina: I can do a quick pass in 10. if CI is green and no migration, i'm fine giving LGTM after verifying perf numbers.

ci-bot: CI status for PR #7824 — all checks passed (unit, integration, lint). flaky-integration rerun passed on second try.

alex: thanks — note: integration flaky due to test timeout, I increased timeout by 20s. command to repro locally: 
```
pytest tests/integration/test_kvcache.py::TestEviction -k eviction --maxfail=1 -q
```

maria: quick read — left one small comment about a potential race in the eviction path. not blocking but would prefer a tiny guard.

jamie: saw the comment, alex can you add the guard and push? if it's non-invasive i'll approve after that.

alex: pushed fix at 2138457020, updated test to cover the race.

ci-bot: CI triggered for commit abc123 -> all checks passed.

lina: walked through code, tests look good and change is straightforward. giving LGTM. :thumbsup: 

sanjay: gave LGTM as well. go for merge once you hit the cutoff window.

deploy-bot: Release window scheduled: cutover at 22:00 UTC. Automated rollback policy enabled.

alex: merging now. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. will monitor stderr and latency dashboards post-cutover. :rocket: 

jamie: cheers — please post a brief note in #incidents if any regression shows up.

alex: will do.
